country.evidence_quote: CycleNation is more than a program it’s an active movement empowering people across the country to use road and stationary bikes to get brain and heart healthy — all while raising funds to end the cycle of stroke and heart disease. Cycling is core to our mission and helps maintain strong brain function, processing speed and mental sharpness. Let’s celebrate our power to transform health in America and band together for a high-energy, endorphin-pumping ride where everyone is a winner.
